changes.comment: Resolve PNPM catalog references (such as "catalog:" or "catalog:tools") to the catalog versions when Rush calculates implicitly preferred versions. This fixes a "TypeError: Invalid comparator" crash in "rush install" when a package in the "preferredVersions" of common-versions.json is referenced through a catalog, and restores the narrowing of transitive dependency ranges for those packages. "rush install" also no longer crashes when a preferred version can't be compared as a SemVer range.
